data.label: u32a

in_process_readback.source: env_probe node appended to product_pdf.pipe (same task process as the measured nodes)

rulings.A: unconstrained on every vCPU; denominator = host nproc; engine, driver and host CPU reported separately; idle spin measured in this posture
rulings.C: one workload on the box; each leg records containers, strays and the host idle baseline it assumed

legs.submission_shape: send_files, K=1, one batch in flight, barrier between batches

throughput.basis: MEASURED — first submit to last return, one clock

cost.available_cpus_source: host nproc (Ruling A); arm cgroup reports '0-31' via cgroup cpuset.cpus.effective

idle_spin_measured.basis: arm cgroup cpu.stat with the pipeline loaded and nothing submitted

cost.basis: engine: arm cgroup cpu.stat at the leg's t0/t1; driver: getrusage self+children over the same window; host: per-core /proc/stat

percore_host.basis: host /proc/stat per-cpu lines over the arm's cpuset; idle = idle+iowait; sees every process on those cores, not only the arm
percore_host.net_of_spin_basis: raw idle + measured idle spin: the spin is busy CPU doing no work, so it is unused capacity

stray_processes.basis: per-process /proc/<pid>/stat utime+stime delta, excluding the arm's cgroup.procs and the driver itself

box_hygiene.ruling: C — one workload on the box; the leg records the baseline it assumed

quiet_box_before.basis: /proc/stat aggregate busy − arm cgroup usage_usec rate, one window

not_swept.embedding_batch: SOURCE READING, not measured: engine embedding_transformer buffers maxDocuments=64 and calls encode() at the sentence-transformers default; the LlamaIndex service never sets embed_batch_size (LlamaIndex default 10). Neither is reachable without changing an arm, so neither was swept.

data.scope_note: A smoke-sized slice ranks K; its absolute docs/s must not sit in a table beside a 10k figure (DOCS_HANDOFF §3.4: wave count biases short runs).
